release_checkpoints.cause: BF_CAPSULE_SOURCE_DRIFT: two unchanged BD definitions were incorrectly listed as BF replacements; removed them without relaxing capsule guard.
New BF installed; committed manifest still only AC..BE, so determinism check correctly failed until build.

release_checkpoints.note: Capture of BF rollback state only; not yet a rollback cycle proof.

release_checkpoints.cause: Two fixture assumptions: AU seeded a different master set before BF copied it; separately, G-01 hosted alignment already grants authenticated schema USAGE. BF now runs before AU, and explicit HOSTED_USAGE fixture profile preserves the original complete schema ACL. Product grants are unchanged.

R08 requires identification before Laundry BS receipt, not at later classification; R12 changed a physical color and violated the one-construction commercial-range invariant. HTTP fixtures assumed the AN no-USAGE baseline instead of captured hosted ACL.
R08 checked an uncoded refusal with a product-code parser; R12 name-only edit did not create a physical successor. Nested supplier fixture helper revoked its caller schema grant.
R12 is now PASS with a real same-construction physical successor. Remaining R08 oracle parser and nested fixture grant defects are corrected in a97962f; no product guard was weakened.

remaining: Independent final CP6 retest/acceptance is separate; CP6 HOLD, production_go=false, audit_complete=false, CP7 not authorized.

prior_failure.cause: BF_RESTORED_CATALOG_DRIFT: re-parsing the varchar rate_basis CHECK from pg_get_constraintdef changed the internal cast tree. Reconstruct the original IN expression through the existing G-01 check_source helper; strict whole-catalog equality is unchanged. BF transaction rolled back; later 29 cascade failures were consequences. Runner now stops at first failed restore.

rollback_qualification.comparison_rules: Strict catalogue, migration ledgers and predecessor business data; reinstall comparison excludes capsule capture time/boundary and seeded rows installation time/event IDs as recorded by the existing rollback verifier.

boundaries: R03 same-size distinct work references require separate physical waves.
R08 unidentified Laundry BS receipt refuses before partial financial or physical facts; normal laundry still does not require final SKU.
R10 SalesPages remains an existing simulation; native sales/return engine proof is not connected browser sale posting proof.
R12 exercises two actual physical identity versions with the same construction/root/size and explicit product_id disambiguation; it is not all possible historical imports.
R14 exercises two real locations, a zero-stock member, pending/late/inverse costs, and an empty Grade B filter; no nonempty mixed-grade inventory claim.
No production/UAT/legacy writes, no deployment or merge, no CP7 permission.

auxiliary_regressions.cause: Both direct reads/writes are correctly denied with SQLSTATE 42501 at the table boundary. The legacy test expected schema denial after its nested fixture used to revoke caller USAGE. Test now selects the precise denial boundary and additionally checks 42501 and complete schema ACL preservation; product permissions unchanged.
